ruling.e8_chain: RETIRED. B9 and B10 close as superseded, not as completed. The integration half of B9 was done and verified upstream; the replay half and B10's ledger cannot be satisfied because their source bytes no longer exist. Ordinal 418 is recorded as permanently unadjudicable. No verdict was fabricated at any point and fail-closed held throughout.
ruling.gate: RE-ANCHORED AND SCOPED. The standing rule no longer reads as a blanket freeze on every model-stack/lineup/registry change pending an E8-form reseed. It now names the current eras and states the protection it actually provides.
ruling.gate_scope_after_ruling: A quality-baseline reseed gates AUTOPILOT QUALITY DECISIONS - applying or publishing a quality baseline, and any change that would invalidate an in-flight baseline while it is being collected. It does not gate stack-template, lineup or registry changes in general, which have been shipping through it since 2026-08-11 regardless.

gates_bind_at_promotion_not_at_discovery.operator_direction_20260827: AutoKernel must not be bogged down by baggage; it needs to find faster, more efficient kernels. The gates apply when the operator chooses to promote an aggregate candidate to production.
gates_bind_at_promotion_not_at_discovery.rule: Era fences, baseline reseeds and rebaseline holds bind at the PROMOTION boundary - applying a baseline, publishing a claim, or cutting a new production kernel. They do NOT bind discovery, screening or characterisation, which emit observations and never claims.
why_this_is_safe_not_a_relaxation: the production kernel is FROZEN: production-consolidated-v9 @ 0db32c06e, ratified, with the branch pattern production-consolidated-* pinned in human_only_paths.yaml:42-49 and on_pin_mismatch: refuse
AutoKernel builds only in throwaway worktrees off llama.cpp-experimental; discovery has no write path to the frozen tree
every discovery receipt is already stamped promotion_claim: false by construction, so a screen cannot become a claim by accident
the constitution already places custody at CLAIM time (P-GPU-1), not at experiment time: a screening run that is wrong is simply refused later
gates_bind_at_promotion_not_at_discovery.consequence_for_autokernel: The fail-closed E8 AutoPilot rebaseline hold cited at autokernel-research-loop.md:806-811 is a PROMOTION-time obligation for a kernel cutover. It does not gate running screens, and no AutoKernel campaign should stop or refuse to start on account of it.
gates_bind_at_promotion_not_at_discovery.what_still_binds_at_promotion: Unchanged: correctness before speed, P-GPU-1 for a decision-grade number, the frozen-kernel workflow (branch from the current production tip, validate, deploy as a NEW version), and operator authorisation for any production cutover.

ruling.restatements: This ruling supersedes every restatement of the E8-form gate in the handoff tree. The gate text in CURRENT-CAMPAIGN.md is the single source of truth; handoffs asserting the old E8 form are stale on that point and inherit this ruling without needing individual edits.
ruling.orchestrator_guard: orchestrator_stack.py's refusal to start/stop/reload while a reseed process is RUNNING is left in place. It is a concurrency interlock, not the E8 gate, and is inert while no reseed runs.
